332 
Part 4 Nutrition Therapy
Gingko biloba;
ying xing
Gingko biloba
Inhibit platelet aggregation; improve
circulation; treat coronary thrombosis
No agreed-upon standards exist; different formulations will 
vary in actual content. Affects platelet activating factor; use 
with caution in patients taking atnicoagulant or antiplatelet
therapy. May cause elevated blood glucose levels in those
taking insulin or oral hypoglycemic agents. Increases blood 
pressure when combined with thiazide diuretics. Do not use
with trazodone.
Gotu kola; brahmi
Centella asiatica
Treat hypertension
Well tolerated. High doses may interfere with actions of 
antidiabetic medications & cholesterol-lowering drugs.
Contraindicated in pregnancy and breast-feeding.
